description: SNPA - ELDP Recreational Route is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Snowdonia National Park Authority. Dataset showing linear routes protected for recreational purposes under Strategic Policy L - Accessibility and Transport of the Eryri Local Development Plan (ELDP), the limit of each area is recorded as a polyline. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Snowdonia National Park Authority. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
